metadata.notes: Folleto promocional de la destilería canadiense Gooderham & Worts (Toronto). Incluye recetas de cócteles intercaladas con anuncios de sus productos (G & W Special Rye, Hyde Park Dry Gin, Argyle Old Nectar Whisky, Plantation Bourbon, etc.). El nombre del libro aparece como 'Goderham' en el archivo, pero la marca correcta es 'Gooderham'.

sections.title: Hyde Park London Dry Gin
sections.content_original: Hyde Park London Dry Gin is a distilled crystal clear Gin made from the finest grain spirit and selected juniper berries, etc. Hyde Park is the best Gin obtainable for Cocktails, Fizzes and Rickeys.
sections.content_es: Hyde Park London Dry Gin es una ginebra destilada cristalina elaborada con el mejor alcohol de grano y bayas de enebro seleccionadas, etc. Hyde Park es la mejor ginebra disponible para cócteles, fizzes y rickeys.

sections.title: G & W Special
sections.content_original: G & W Special. Famous for almost a century. Its delicate bouquet and mellow flavour is due to being allowed to mature in oak casks for seven years or more.
sections.content_es: G & W Special. Famoso desde hace casi un siglo. Su delicado bouquet y sabor suave se deben a su maduración en barricas de roble durante siete años o más.

sections.title: Royal York Five Star Old Highland Whisky
sections.title_es: Royal York Five Star Old Highland Whisky
sections.content_original: Royal York Five Star Old Highland Whisky. Composed of the finest Islay and Glenlivet Scotch malt whiskies and selected grain. Aged in wood for many years and blended by Scotch Whisky experts for the discriminating taste.
sections.content_es: Royal York Five Star Old Highland Whisky. Compuesto por los mejores whiskies escoceses de malta Islay y Glenlivet y grano seleccionado. Envejecido en madera durante muchos años y mezclado por expertos escoceses en whisky para el paladar más exigente.

sections.title: Instructions for Mixing Punches in Quantities
sections.title_es: Instrucciones para preparar ponches en grandes cantidades
sections.content_original: Instructions and recipes for mixing punches in quantities for a large number of guests at parties or receptions. For mixing punches in large quantities, endeavor to obtain a mixing vessel of agate ware or porcelain lined. When all the ingredients for the punch have been put into the mixing vessel, stir with an oaken paddle and set the mixture in the ice box and let it stand not less than six hours, not more than ten. Put no ice in the basic mixture. When the time arrives to serve the punch add the carbonated water or champagne if they are called for in the recipe. When serving punches place on the serving table a punch bowl of sufficient capacity for the occasion and keep mixing vessel convenient in order the serving bowl may be replenished as required. Select a large block of ice and put in serving bowl, ornament the top of the ice with such berries and fruits in season as appropriate for the kind of punch being served.
sections.content_es: Instrucciones y recetas para preparar ponches en grandes cantidades para muchos invitados en fiestas o recepciones. Para mezclar ponches en grandes cantidades, procure conseguir un recipiente de loza vidriada o con revestimiento de porcelana. Cuando se hayan colocado todos los ingredientes del ponche en el recipiente, remueva con una pala de roble y guarde la mezcla en la nevera al menos seis horas y no más de diez. No añada hielo a la mezcla base. Cuando llegue el momento de servir el ponche, agregue el agua carbonatada o champán si la receta lo requiere. Al servir, coloque sobre la mesa un cuenco de ponche con capacidad suficiente para la ocasión y mantenga el recipiente de mezcla cerca para reponer el cuenco según sea necesario. Elija un bloque grande de hielo, póngalo en el cuenco y adorne la parte superior del hielo con bayas y frutas de temporada apropiadas para el ponche que se vaya a servir.

sections.title: G & W Martini Cocktail
sections.content_original: G & W Martini Cocktail. Only the finest French and Italian Vermouths together with Hyde Park Dry Gin and Orange Bitters make this pleasing, ready to serve Cocktail.
sections.content_es: Cóctel Martini G & W. Solo los mejores vermuts franceses e italianos junto con Hyde Park Dry Gin y amargos de naranja crean este agradable cóctel listo para servir.

sections.title: Plantation Bourbon Whiskey
sections.content_original: Plantation Bourbon Whiskey is distilled by practical distillers of American Whiskies and aged in charred oak barrels for many years.
sections.content_es: Plantation Bourbon Whiskey está destilado por destiladores expertos de whiskies americanos y envejecido en barricas de roble carbonizado durante muchos años.

recipes.method_original: This is a long drink, use tumbler. Place 1 teaspoonful of Creme de Menthe in the tumbler, half fill with cracked ice. In another glass mix the following: 1/3 Orange juice, 1/3 Grenadine, 1/3 French Vermouth, 1/3 Brandy. Pour into first glass, dash the top with Old Portugal Port, add a little fresh fruits and a sprig of mint and serve with a straw.
recipes.method_es: Es un trago largo, use un vaso tumbler. Coloque 1 cucharadita de crema de menta en el vaso, llene hasta la mitad con hielo picado. En otro vaso mezcle: 1/3 de zumo de naranja, 1/3 de granadina, 1/3 de vermut francés y 1/3 de brandy. Vierta sobre el primer vaso, eche por encima un golpe de oporto Old Portugal, añada un poco de fruta fresca y una ramita de menta y sirva con pajita.
recipes.garnish: Frutas frescas y ramita de menta
recipes.raw_text: American Beauty. This is a long drink, use tumbler. 1 teaspoonful Creme de Menthe. 1/2 fill with cracked ice. In another glass mix the following: 1/3 Orange juice, 1/3 Grenadine, 1/3 French Vermouth, 1/3 Brandy. Pour in to first glass, dash the top with Old Portugal Port, add little fresh fruits and a sprig of mint and serve with a straw.

recipes.method_original: In a shaker use: 2/3 Hyde Park London Dry Gin, 1/3 French Vermouth, 1 dash Orange or Angostura Bitters. Serve with stuffed olive.
recipes.method_es: En una coctelera ponga: 2/3 de ginebra Hyde Park London Dry, 1/3 de vermut francés, 1 golpe de amargo de naranja o Angostura. Sirva con aceituna rellena.
recipes.raw_text: Astoria Cocktail. In a shaker use: 2/3 Hyde Park London Dry Gin, 1/3 French Vermouth, 1 dash Orange or Angostura Bitters. Serve with stuffed olive.

recipes.method_original: In a shaker use: 1/3 Hyde Park London Dry Gin, 2/3 Bacardi Rum, 1 teaspoonful Grenadine, juice of half a lime. Add ice and agitate slowly.
recipes.method_es: En una coctelera ponga: 1/3 de ginebra Hyde Park London Dry, 2/3 de ron Bacardí, 1 cucharadita de granadina, el zumo de media lima. Añada hielo y agite suavemente.
recipes.raw_text: Bacardi Cocktail. In a shaker use: 1/3 Hyde Park London Dry Gin, 2/3 Bacardi Rum, 1 teaspoonful Grenadine, Juice of half a lime. Add ice and agitate slowly.

recipes.method_original: Fill large glass 3/4 full shaved ice. 1/2 Hyde Park London Dry Gin, 1/4 French Vermouth, 1/4 Italian Vermouth, 1 slice Orange. Shake well; strain into cocktail glasses and serve.
recipes.method_es: Llene un vaso grande con hielo en escamas hasta 3/4. Añada 1/2 de ginebra Hyde Park London Dry, 1/4 de vermut francés, 1/4 de vermut italiano y 1 rodaja de naranja. Agite bien; cuele en copas de cóctel y sirva.
recipes.raw_text: Bronx Cocktail. Fill large glass 3/4 full shaved ice. 1/2 Hyde Park London Dry Gin, 1/2 French Vermouth, 1/4 Italian Vermouth, 1 slice Orange. Shake well; strain into cocktail glasses and serve.

recipes.method_original: In a large jug put 3 lumps of ice and add: 1 liqueur glass Brandy, 2 liqueur glasses Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 bottle Lanson Champagne, 1 bottle Soda Water. Stir well and decorate with fruits in season and sprig of fresh mint.
recipes.method_es: En una jarra grande coloque 3 cubos de hielo y añada: 1 copa de licor de brandy, 2 copas de licor de Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 botella de champán Lanson, 1 botella de agua de sifón. Remueva bien y decore con frutas de temporada y una ramita de menta fresca.
recipes.garnish: Frutas de temporada y ramita de menta fresca
recipes.raw_text: Champagne Cup. In a large jug put 3 lumps of ice and add: 1 liqueur glass Brandy, 2 liqueur glasses Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 bottle Lanson Champagne, 1 bottle Soda Water. Stir well and decorate with fruits in season and sprig of fresh mint.

recipes.method_original: In a large glass or shaker put: 2/3 G & W Special, 1/3 Italian Vermouth, Dash of Angostura Bitters. Shake well with crushed ice and strain into cocktail glass. Serve with a piece of twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso grande o coctelera ponga: 2/3 de G & W Special, 1/3 de vermut italiano, un golpe de amargo Angostura. Agite bien con hielo picado y cuele en copa de cóctel. Sirva con una corteza de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Canadian Rye Cocktail. In a large glass or shaker put: 2/3 G & W Special, 1/3 Italian Vermouth, Dash of Angostura Bitters. Shake well with crushed ice and strain into cocktail glass. Serve with a piece of twisted lemon peel.

ingredients.notes: Llenar la mitad de la coctelera

ingredients.item_es: Zumo de lima (o de media limón)

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with cracked ice. 2/3 Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/3 Italian Vermouth, 1 White of Egg, juice of a small Lime (or 1/2 Lemon), 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine, sprig of fresh mint. Shake well, strain and leave mint leaf on top.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. Añada 2/3 de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, 1/3 de vermut italiano, 1 clara de huevo, el zumo de una lima pequeña (o de medio limón), 1 cucharadita de granadina y una ramita de menta fresca. Agite bien, cuele y deje una hoja de menta encima.
recipes.raw_text: Clover Leaf Cocktail. Half fill shaker with cracked ice. 2/3 Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/3 Italian Vermouth, 1 White of Egg, Juice of a small Lime (or 1/2 Lemon), 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine, Sprig of fresh mint. Shake well, strain and leave mint leaf on top.

recipes.method_original: In a large glass or shaker put: 1 wineglass of Hyde Park Dry Gin, juice of one Lemon, 1 teaspoonful of Sugar or Gomme. Add last 1 teaspoonful of fresh Cream. Shake well, strain into wineglass and squirt of soda on top.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso grande o coctelera ponga: 1 copa de vino de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, el zumo de un limón, 1 cucharadita de azúcar o jarabe de goma. Añada al final 1 cucharadita de nata fresca. Agite bien, cuele en copa de vino y eche un chorrito de soda por encima.
recipes.raw_text: Cream Fizz. In a large glass or shaker put: 1 wineglass of Hyde Park Dry Gin, Juice of one Lemon, 1 teaspoonful of Sugar or Gomme. Add last 1 teaspoonful of fresh Cream. Shake well, strain into wineglass and squirt of soda on top.

ingredients.item_es: Whisky de centeno G & W Four Roses

recipes.method_original: 1 dash of Jamaica Ginger, 1 teaspoonful of Lemon Juice, 1 teaspoonful Rock Candy Syrup, 1 glass of G & W Four Roses Rye. Stir together and serve in same glass.
recipes.method_es: 1 golpe de jengibre de Jamaica, 1 cucharadita de zumo de limón, 1 cucharadita de jarabe de azúcar cande, 1 vaso de whisky de centeno G & W Four Roses. Remueva todo y sirva en el mismo vaso.
recipes.raw_text: Flu Cocktail. 1 dash of Jamaica Ginger, 1 teaspoonful of Lemon Juice, 1 teaspoonful Rock Candy Syrup, 1 glass of G & W Four Roses Rye. Stir together and serve in same glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill the shaker half full with chopped ice and add 1 fresh Egg, 1/2 teaspoonful of Sugar, 1 glass of Brandy, 1 glass of Rum, the remainder fresh Milk. Shake well, and strain into medium sized tumbler. Grate a little nutmeg on top and serve.
recipes.method_es: Llene la coctelera hasta la mitad con hielo picado y añada 1 huevo fresco, 1/2 cucharadita de azúcar, 1 vaso de brandy, 1 vaso de ron y el resto de leche fresca. Agite bien y cuele en un vaso tumbler de tamaño mediano. Ralle un poco de nuez moscada por encima y sirva.
recipes.raw_text: Egg Nogg. Fill the shaker half full with chopped ice and add 1 fresh Egg, 1/2 teaspoonful of Sugar, 1 glass of Brandy, 1 glass of Rum, the remainder fresh Milk. Shake well, and strain into medium sized tumbler. Grate a little nutmeg on top and serve.

recipes.method_original: Put one lump of ice in a tumbler, cut a fresh lime in half and squeeze juice in the glass, and add one glass of Hyde Park London Dry Gin, fill balance of glass with Soda or Seltzer Water.
recipes.method_es: Ponga un cubo de hielo en un vaso tumbler, corte una lima fresca por la mitad y exprima el zumo en el vaso, añada un vaso de ginebra Hyde Park London Dry y llene el resto con agua de sifón o seltzer.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Rickey. Put one lump of ice in a tumbler, cut a fresh lime in half and squeeze juice in the glass, and add one glass of Hyde Park London Dry Gin, fill balance of glass with Soda or Seltzer Water.

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with chipped ice. One wineglass Hyde Park Dry Gin, dash of Angostura Bitters, few drops of Plain Syrup. Shake well - serve in small glass very cold with small piece of Lemon Peel added.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. Una copa de vino de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, un golpe de amargo Angostura, unas gotas de jarabe simple. Agite bien y sirva en un vaso pequeño muy frío con una pequeña corteza de limón.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Daisy. Half fill shaker with chipped ice. One wineglass Hyde Park Dry Gin, Dash of Angostura Bitters, Few drops of Plain Syrup. Shake well - serve in small glass very cold with small piece of Lemon Peel added.

recipes.method_original: In a large tumbler: 1 wineglass of Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1 teaspoonful of Sugar or Gomme, juice of one Lemon, Yolk of one fresh Egg. Shake well; strain into fizz glass, fill up with soda or seltzer water and serve immediately.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso tumbler grande: 1 copa de vino de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, 1 cucharadita de azúcar o jarabe de goma, el zumo de un limón, la yema de un huevo fresco. Agite bien; cuele en un vaso de fizz, llene con soda o agua seltzer y sirva de inmediato.
recipes.raw_text: Golden Fizz. In a large tumbler: 1 wineglass of Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1 teaspoonful of Sugar or Gomme, Juice of one Lemon, Yolk of one fresh Egg. Shake well; strain into fizz glass, fill up with soda or seltzer water and serve immediately.

recipes.method_original: Peel a whole rind of lemon as you would an apple, put rind in large tumbler, add a few lumps of ice, one teaspoonful of sugar, one wineglass of Hyde Park Dry Gin; then fill up with Ginger Ale.
recipes.method_es: Pele toda la corteza de un limón como si fuera una manzana, ponga la corteza en un vaso tumbler grande, añada unos cubos de hielo, una cucharadita de azúcar y una copa de vino de ginebra Hyde Park Dry; luego llene con ginger ale.
recipes.garnish: Corteza entera de limón en espiral
recipes.raw_text: Horse's Neck. Peel a whole rind of lemon as you would an apple, put rind in large tumbler, add a few lumps of ice, one teaspoonful of sugar, one wineglass of Hyde Park Dry Gin; then fill up with Ginger Ale.

recipes.method_original: Put 3 or 4 lumps of ice in a large tumbler, juice of 1 Lemon, 2 teaspoonfuls of Sugar, 1 glass of Hyde Park London Dry Gin. Fill balance of glass with Soda Water, stir well and serve.
recipes.method_es: Coloque 3 o 4 cubos de hielo en un vaso tumbler grande, el zumo de 1 limón, 2 cucharaditas de azúcar y 1 vaso de ginebra Hyde Park London Dry. Llene el resto del vaso con agua de sifón, remueva bien y sirva.
recipes.raw_text: John Collins. Put 3 or 4 lumps of ice in a large tumbler, juice of 1 Lemon, 2 teaspoonfuls of Sugar, 1 glass of Hyde Park London Dry Gin. Fill balance of glass with Soda Water, stir well and serve.

recipes.method_original: 2 dashes of Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 dash Maraschino, 1 dash Angostura Bitters, 1 wineglass Bushmill Irish Whiskey. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass, add olive and squeeze lemon peel on top, and serve.
recipes.method_es: 2 golpes de Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 golpe de marrasquino, 1 golpe de amargo Angostura, 1 copa de vino de whiskey irlandés Bushmill. Agite bien, cuele en copa de cóctel, añada una aceituna y exprima corteza de limón por encima, y sirva.
recipes.garnish: Aceituna y corteza de limón exprimida
recipes.raw_text: Irish Cocktail. 2 dashes of Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 dash Maraschino, 1 dash Angostura Bitters, 1 wineglass Bushmill Irish Whiskey. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass, add olive and squeeze lemon peel on top, and serve.

ingredients.item_original: G & W Four Roses Rye Whiskey
ingredients.item_es: Whisky de centeno G & W Four Roses

recipes.method_original: Fill shaker 1/2 full cracked ice. 2/3 G & W Four Roses Rye Whiskey, 1/3 Italian Vermouth, dash of Angostura Bitters. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass, with cherry. (Named after the island on which stands New York City.)
recipes.method_es: Llene la coctelera hasta la mitad con hielo picado. 2/3 de whisky de centeno G & W Four Roses, 1/3 de vermut italiano, un golpe de amargo Angostura. Agite bien, cuele en copa de cóctel con una cereza. (Llamado así por la isla sobre la que se levanta la ciudad de Nueva York.)
recipes.raw_text: Manhattan Cocktail. Fill shaker 1/2 full cracked ice. 2/3 G & W Four Roses Rye Whiskey, 1/3 Italian Vermouth, dash of Angostura Bitters. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass, with cherry. (Named after the island on which stands New York City.)

recipes.method_original: Fill shaker 2/3 full cracked ice and add 2/3 Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/4 French Vermouth, 1/4 Italian Vermouth. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass. If a more dry Martini is required use less Italian Vermouth and vice versa if a sweeter cocktail is wanted.
recipes.method_es: Llene la coctelera con hielo picado hasta 2/3 y añada 2/3 de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, 1/4 de vermut francés y 1/4 de vermut italiano. Agite bien y cuele en copa de cóctel. Si se desea un Martini más seco, use menos vermut italiano; si se prefiere más dulce, al revés.
recipes.raw_text: Martini Cocktail. Fill shaker 2/3 full cracked ice and add 2/3 Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/4 French Vermouth, 1/4 Italian Vermouth. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass. If a more dry Martini is required use less Italian Vermouth and vice versa if a sweeter cocktail is wanted.

ingredients.item_es: G & W Four Roses (whisky de centeno)

recipes.method_original: Fill shaker 2/3 full cracked ice. 1 white of a fresh Egg, 2 dashes of Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine. Add G & W Four Roses to required strength. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass.
recipes.method_es: Llene la coctelera con hielo picado hasta 2/3. Añada 1 clara de huevo fresco, 2 golpes de Cointreau Triple Sec y 1 cucharadita de granadina. Añada G & W Four Roses hasta la intensidad deseada. Agite bien y cuele en copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Millionaire Cocktail. Fill shaker 2/3 full cracked ice. 1 white of a fresh Egg, 2 dashes of Cointreau Triple Sec, 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine. Add G & W Four Roses to required strength. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass.

ingredients.item_original: Orange, lemon, pineapple slices and cherries
ingredients.item_es: Rodajas de naranja, limón, piña y cerezas

recipes.method_original: One teaspoonful of sugar, 1/2 wineglass of water, 3 or 4 sprigs of fresh mint, muddle well until flavour of mint is well extracted; then take out mint and add 2 glasses of Plantation Bourbon Whiskey. Fill tumbler with shaved ice, stir well until glass gets frosted, then take some sprigs of mint and insert them in the ice stem downwards, so that the leaves will be on the surface in the shape of a bouquet. Add slices of orange, lemon, pineapple, and cherries on top.
recipes.method_es: Una cucharadita de azúcar, 1/2 copa de agua, 3 o 4 ramitas de menta fresca, machacar bien hasta que se extraiga el aroma de la menta; luego retirar la menta y añadir 2 vasos de whisky bourbon Plantation. Llenar el vaso tumbler con hielo en escamas, remover hasta que el vaso se escarche, luego tomar unas ramitas de menta e insertarlas en el hielo con el tallo hacia abajo, de modo que las hojas queden en la superficie en forma de ramo. Añadir rodajas de naranja, limón, piña y cerezas por encima.
recipes.garnish: Ramillete de menta, rodajas de naranja, limón, piña y cerezas
recipes.raw_text: Mint Julep. One teaspoonful of sugar, 1/2 wineglass of water, 3 or 4 sprigs of fresh mint, muddle well until flavour of mint is well extracted: then take out mint and add 2 glasses of Plantation Bourbon Whiskey. Fill tumbler with shaved ice, stir well until glass gets frosted, then take some sprigs of mint and insert them in the ice stem downwards, so that the leaves will be on the surface in the shape of a bouquet. Add slices of orange, lemon, pineapple, and cherries on top.

recipes.method_original: 2/3 fill shaker with cracked ice. 1 white of a fresh Egg, 1/4 Lemon Syrup, 1/4 French Vermouth, 2/3 G & W Special Rye, 3 dashes Orange Bitters. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass with cherry.
recipes.method_es: Llene la coctelera con hielo picado hasta 2/3. Añada 1 clara de huevo fresco, 1/4 de jarabe de limón, 1/4 de vermut francés, 2/3 de G & W Special Rye y 3 golpes de amargo de naranja. Agite bien y cuele en copa de cóctel con una cereza.
recipes.raw_text: Mountain Cocktail. 2/3 fill shaker with cracked ice. 1 white of a fresh Egg, 1/4 Lemon Syrup, 1/4 French Vermouth, 2/3 G & W Special Rye, 3 dashes Orange Bitters. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass with cherry.

recipes.method_original: 1 white of Egg, 1 teaspoonful of Sugar, 2 dashes of Fleur d'Oranger, 1 glass of Hyde Park London Dry Gin, juice of 1 Lemon, 2/3 the shaker of cracked ice, lastly 1/2 wineglass of fresh Cream. Shake for about two minutes, then strain into tumbler, and fill balance with soda.
recipes.method_es: 1 clara de huevo, 1 cucharadita de azúcar, 2 golpes de agua de azahar, 1 vaso de ginebra Hyde Park London Dry, el zumo de 1 limón, 2/3 de la coctelera con hielo picado y, por último, 1/2 copa de vino de nata fresca. Agite durante unos dos minutos, cuele en un vaso tumbler y llene el resto con soda.
recipes.raw_text: New Orleans Gin Fizz. 1 white of Egg, 1 teaspoonful of Sugar, 2 dashes of Fleur d'Oranger, 1 glass of Hyde Park London Dry Gin, juice of 1 Lemon, 2/3 the shaker of cracked ice, lastly 1/2 wineglass of fresh Cream. Shake for about two minutes, then strain into tumbler, and fill balance with soda.

ingredients.item_es: Whisky de centeno G & W Old Rye

recipes.method_original: Take a small tumbler and put into it 4 dashes of Angostura Bitters, 1 lump of ice, 1 glass of G & W Old Rye Whiskey, 1 tablespoonful of Castor Sugar. Stir well until sugar is dissolved, then squeeze lemon peel on top and serve in same glass as mixed.
recipes.method_es: Tome un vaso pequeño y ponga 4 golpes de amargo Angostura, 1 cubo de hielo, 1 vaso de whisky de centeno G & W Old Rye y 1 cucharada de azúcar fino. Remueva bien hasta que el azúcar se disuelva, exprima corteza de limón por encima y sirva en el mismo vaso en el que se preparó.
recipes.raw_text: Old Fashioned Whiskey Cocktail. Take a small tumbler and put into it 4 dashes of Angostura Bitters, 1 lump of ice, 1 glass of G & W Old Rye Whiskey, 1 tablespoonful of Castor Sugar. Stir well until sugar is dissolved, then squeeze lemon peel on top and serve in same glass as mixed.

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with chipped ice. 1/4 Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/4 Italian Vermouth, 1/4 French Vermouth, 1 teaspoonful of White Mint, 1 dash of Orange Bitters. Shake well and strain into cocktail glasses.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. 1/4 de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, 1/4 de vermut italiano, 1/4 de vermut francés, 1 cucharadita de crema de menta blanca, 1 golpe de amargo de naranja. Agite bien y cuele en copas de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Pall Mall Cocktail. Half fill shaker with chipped ice. 1/4 Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/4 Italian Vermouth, 1/4 French Vermouth, 1 teaspoonful of White Mint, 1 dash of Orange Bitters. Shake well and strain into cocktail glasses.

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with chipped ice. 1 white of a fresh Egg, 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine, 1 teaspoonful of Lemon Juice, 1 teaspoonful of fresh Cream, 2/3 Hyde Park Dry Gin. Shake well and strain into cocktail glasses.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. 1 clara de huevo fresco, 1 cucharadita de granadina, 1 cucharadita de zumo de limón, 1 cucharadita de nata fresca, 2/3 de ginebra Hyde Park Dry. Agite bien y cuele en copas de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Pink Rose Cocktail. Half fill shaker with chipped ice. 1 white of a fresh Egg, 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine, 1 teaspoonful of Lemon Juice, 1 teaspoonful of fresh Cream, 2/3 Hyde Park Dry Gin. Shake well and strain into cocktail glasses.

recipes.method_original: Can be made in many varieties by pouring the heaviest liqueurs in rotation in your Pousse Cafe glass, the following is quite a good one. 1/6 Anisette Syrup, 1/6 Cherry Brandy, 1/6 Cointreau Triple Sec, 1/6 Yellow Chartreuse, 1/6 Green Chartreuse, 1/6 Grand Marnier. Great care should be taken so as to avoid the different Liqueurs from running together.
recipes.method_es: Puede hacerse de muchas variedades vertiendo los licores más pesados en orden en una copa pousse café; este es uno bastante bueno. 1/6 de jarabe de anisado, 1/6 de brandy de cereza, 1/6 de Cointreau Triple Sec, 1/6 de Chartreuse amarillo, 1/6 de Chartreuse verde, 1/6 de Grand Marnier. Hay que tener mucho cuidado para evitar que los distintos licores se mezclen entre sí.
recipes.raw_text: Pousse Cafe. Can be made in many varieties by pouring the heaviest liqueurs in rotation in your Pousse Cafe glass, the following is quite a good one. 1/6 Anisette Syrup, 1/6 Cherry Brandy, 1/6 Cointreau Triple Sec, 1/6 Yellow Chartreuse, 1/6 Green Chartreuse, 1/6 Grand Marnier. Great care should be taken so as to avoid the different Liqueurs from running together.

ingredients.item_original: Green Mint leaves, cut in half
ingredients.item_es: Hojas de menta verde, cortadas por la mitad

ingredients.notes: En el cuenco para mantenerlo frío

recipes.method_original: One large tumbler G & W Special Rye, 4 lumps of Sugar, one Lemon sliced, one Orange sliced, twelve leaves of Green Mint, cut in half. Mix and place on ice for half an hour: then add one quart of ginger ale, and serve. Place large piece of ice in bowl to keep punch cool.
recipes.method_es: Un vaso tumbler grande de G & W Special Rye, 4 terrones de azúcar, un limón en rodajas, una naranja en rodajas, doce hojas de menta verde cortadas por la mitad. Mezcle y coloque sobre hielo durante media hora: luego añada un cuarto (1 quart) de ginger ale y sirva. Coloque un gran bloque de hielo en el cuenco para mantener el ponche frío.
recipes.garnish: Rodajas de limón, naranja y hojas de menta
recipes.raw_text: Rye Whiskey Punch. One large tumbler G & W Special Rye, 4 lumps of Sugar, one Lemon, sliced, one Orange, sliced, twelve leaves of Green Mint, cut in half. Mix and place on ice for half an hour: then add one quart of ginger ale, and serve. Place large piece of ice in bowl to keep punch cool.

ingredients.item_es: Whisky de centeno G & W Special

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with ice. 2/3 G & W Special Rye Whiskey, juice of one Lemon, one teaspoonful of Sugar, one liqueur glass of rich Cream. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass and serve with cherry.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo. 2/3 de whisky de centeno G & W Special, el zumo de un limón, una cucharadita de azúcar, una copa de licor de nata espesa. Agite bien, cuele en copa de cóctel y sirva con una cereza.
recipes.raw_text: Rye Sour. Half fill shaker with ice. 2/3 G & W Special Rye Whiskey, juice of one Lemon, one teaspoonful of Sugar, one liqueur glass of rich Cream. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass and serve with cherry.

ingredients.item_es: Jarabe de azúcar cande o jarabe de goma

recipes.method_original: In a large tumbler: 1 teaspoon of Rock Candy or Gomme Syrup, juice of half a Lemon, 1 wineglass of G & W Special Rye. Stir together and serve in same glass and squeeze lemon peel on top.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso tumbler grande: 1 cucharadita de jarabe de azúcar cande o jarabe de goma, el zumo de medio limón, 1 copa de vino de G & W Special Rye. Remueva todo y sirva en el mismo vaso y exprima corteza de limón por encima.
recipes.raw_text: Rock and Rye. In a large tumbler: 1 teaspoon of Rock Candy or Gomme Syrup, juice of half a Lemon, 1 wineglass of G & W Special Rye. Stir together and serve in same glass and squeeze lemon peel on top.

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with cracked ice. Yolk of a fresh Egg, 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine, juice of half an Orange, juice of half a Lemon, 1 glass of Hyde Park Dry Gin. Shake well and strain into medium sized tumbler. Fill balance with Soda Water.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. La yema de un huevo fresco, 1 cucharadita de granadina, el zumo de media naranja, el zumo de medio limón, 1 vaso de ginebra Hyde Park Dry. Agite bien y cuele en un vaso tumbler de tamaño mediano. Llene el resto con agua de sifón.
recipes.raw_text: Royal Fizz. Half fill shaker with cracked ice. yolk of a fresh Egg, 1 teaspoonful of Grenadine, juice of half an Orange, juice of half a Lemon, 1 glass of Hyde Park Dry Gin. Shake well and strain into medium sized tumbler. Fill balance with Soda Water.

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with chipped ice. 1 teaspoonful of Sugar, 1 fresh Egg, 1 glass of Ross's Sloe Gin. Shake well and strain into medium sized tumbler and fill balance with Ginger Ale.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. 1 cucharadita de azúcar, 1 huevo fresco, 1 vaso de ginebra de endrinas Ross's. Agite bien y cuele en un vaso tumbler mediano y llene el resto con ginger ale.
recipes.raw_text: Ruby Fizz. Half fill shaker with chipped ice. 1 teaspoonful of Sugar, 1 fresh Egg, 1 glass of Ross's Sloe Gin. Shake well and strain into medium sized tumbler and fill balance with Ginger Ale.

ingredients.item_es: Whisky de centeno G & W Special

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with cracked ice. 1/3 French Vermouth, 1/3 Brandy, 1/3 G & W Special Rye Whiskey. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass and serve with a slice of Lemon.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. 1/3 de vermut francés, 1/3 de brandy, 1/3 de whisky de centeno G & W Special. Agite bien, cuele en copa de cóctel y sirva con una rodaja de limón.
recipes.raw_text: Saratoga Cocktail. Half fill shaker with cracked ice. 1/3 French Vermouth, 1/3 Brandy, 1/3 G & W Special Rye Whiskey. Shake well, strain into cocktail glass and serve with a slice of Lemon.

recipes.method_original: Half fill shaker with cracked ice. 1 glass of Brandy, 2 dashes of Maraschino, 1 dash of Cointreau Triple Sec, 2 dashes of Orange Bitters, 1 teaspoonful of Pineapple Syrup. Shake well, strain into wineglass with 2 strawberries and fill balance of glass with Lanson Champagne.
recipes.method_es: Llene la mitad de la coctelera con hielo picado. 1 vaso de brandy, 2 golpes de marrasquino, 1 golpe de Cointreau Triple Sec, 2 golpes de amargo de naranja, 1 cucharadita de jarabe de piña. Agite bien, cuele en copa de vino con 2 fresas y llene el resto de la copa con champán Lanson.
recipes.raw_text: Saratoga Champagne Cocktail. Half fill shaker with cracked ice. 1 glass of Brandy, 2 dashes of Maraschino, 1 dash of Cointreau Triple Sec, 2 dashes of Orange Bitters, 1 teaspoonful of Pineapple Syrup. Shake well, strain into wineglass with 2 strawberries and fill balance of glass with Lanson Champagne.

recipes.method_original: In a large tumbler put 1 lump of ice, squeeze a piece of lemon peel, one wineglass or more of Argyle Old Nectar Whisky and fill balance of glass with soda water.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso tumbler grande coloque 1 cubo de hielo, exprima una corteza de limón, una copa de vino o más de whisky Argyle Old Nectar y llene el resto del vaso con agua de sifón.
recipes.raw_text: Scotch Highball. In a large tumbler put 1 lump of ice, squeeze a piece of lemon peel, one wineglass or more of Argyle Old Nectar Whisky and fill balance of glass with soda water.

recipes.method_original: Fill shaker 2/3 full of chipped ice. 1/4 glass of Brandy, 1/2 glass of Cointreau Triple Sec, 1/4 glass of Maraschino, one glass of Gonzalez Sherry. Add Syphon. Stir well, decorate with fruits in season. Float a little Port Wine on top.
recipes.method_es: Llene la coctelera con hielo picado hasta 2/3. 1/4 de vaso de brandy, 1/2 vaso de Cointreau Triple Sec, 1/4 de vaso de marrasquino, un vaso de jerez Gonzalez. Añada sifón. Remueva bien y decore con frutas de temporada. Haga flotar un poco de vino de Oporto por encima.
recipes.garnish: Frutas de temporada y un poco de Oporto flotando
recipes.raw_text: Sherry Cobbler. Fill shaker 2/3 full of chipped ice. 1/4 glass of Brandy, 1/2 glass of Cointreau Triple Sec, 1/4 glass of Maraschino, one glass of Gonzalez Sherry. Add Syphon. Stir well, decorate with fruits in season. Float a little Port Wine on top.

recipes.method_original: Into large mixing glass put one cocktail glass Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/2 teaspoonful Sugar, white of one fresh Egg, three dashes of Lemon juice, one cube of ice. Mix well, strain into tall thin glass, and fill balance with Soda Water.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso mezclador grande coloque una copa de cóctel de ginebra Hyde Park Dry, 1/2 cucharadita de azúcar, la clara de un huevo fresco, tres golpes de zumo de limón y un cubo de hielo. Mezcle bien, cuele en un vaso alto y delgado y llene el resto con agua de sifón.
recipes.raw_text: Silver Gin Fizz. Into large mixing glass put one cocktail glass Hyde Park Dry Gin, 1/2 teaspoonful Sugar, white of one fresh Egg, three dashes of Lemon juice, one cube of ice. Mix well, strain into tall thin glass, and fill balance with Soda Water.

recipes.method_original: Fill large tumbler 1/2 full shaved ice. 1 teaspoonful Sugar, juice of half Lime, 1 large wineglass Ross's Sloe Gin. Shake well, strain into fizz glass, fill up with Soda Water and serve immediately as this drink should be taken while effervescing.
recipes.method_es: Llene un vaso tumbler grande hasta la mitad con hielo en escamas. 1 cucharadita de azúcar, el zumo de media lima, 1 copa de vino grande de ginebra de endrinas Ross's. Agite bien, cuele en un vaso de fizz, llene con agua de sifón y sirva de inmediato, ya que esta bebida debe tomarse mientras está efervescente.
recipes.raw_text: Sloe Gin Fizz. Fill large tumbler 1/2 full shaved ice. 1 teaspoonful Sugar, juice of half Lime, 1 large wineglass Ross's Sloe Gin. Shake well, strain into fizz glass, fill up with Soda Water and serve immediately as this drink should be taken while effervescing.

recipes.method_original: In a large tumbler put 1 measure of Vanilla Ice Cream, 2 dashes Maraschino, 2 dashes Cointreau Triple Sec, 2 dashes Brandy. Fill balance with Lanson Champagne; stir well, and add a slice of pineapple, a slice of orange, and a slice of lemon, 2 cherries, 2 strawberries.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso tumbler grande coloque 1 medida de helado de vainilla, 2 golpes de marrasquino, 2 golpes de Cointreau Triple Sec y 2 golpes de brandy. Llene el resto con champán Lanson; remueva bien y añada una rodaja de piña, una rodaja de naranja y una rodaja de limón, 2 cerezas y 2 fresas.
recipes.garnish: Rodajas de piña, naranja y limón, 2 cerezas y 2 fresas
recipes.raw_text: Soyer au Champagne. In a large tumbler put 1 measure of Vanilla Ice Cream, 2 dashes Maraschino, 2 dashes Cointreau Triple Sec, 2 dashes Brandy. Fill balance with Lanson Champagne; stir well, and add a slice of pineapple, a slice of orange, and a slice of lemon, 2 cherries, 2 strawberries.

recipes.method_original: In mixing vessel: 1 lb. powdered Sugar, juice of 6 Lemons, 1 quart of French Claret, 1 quart of Gonzalez Sherry, 1 quart of Argyle Old Nectar Whiskey, 1 quart of Brandy. Mix the above, pour into another bowl into which a block of clear ice has been placed; dress the ice with fruits: pour in one quart of Soda Water and serve in punch glasses or cups.
recipes.method_es: En el recipiente de mezcla: 1 libra de azúcar en polvo, el zumo de 6 limones, 1 cuarto (quart) de clarete francés, 1 cuarto de jerez Gonzalez, 1 cuarto de whisky Argyle Old Nectar y 1 cuarto de brandy. Mezcle lo anterior y vierta en otro cuenco en el que se haya colocado un bloque de hielo transparente; adorne el hielo con frutas: vierta un cuarto de agua de sifón y sirva en vasos o tazas de ponche.
recipes.garnish: Frutas sobre el bloque de hielo
recipes.raw_text: Artillery Punch (For Party of 30). In mixing vessel: 1 lb. powdered Sugar, juice of 6 Lemons, 1 quart of French Claret, 1 quart of Gonzalez Sherry, 1 quart of Argyle Old Nectar Whiskey, 1 quart of Brandy. Mix the above, pour into another bowl into which a block of clear ice has been placed; dress the ice with fruits: pour in one quart of Soda Water and serve in punch glasses or cups.

recipes.method_original: 1 lb. white Sugar, juice of 6 Lemons, 1 quart Guinness Stout, 1 quart Lanson Champagne. Pour into mixture of lemon juice and sugar the Champagne and Stout, ice cold. Serve in punch glasses dressed with fruit.
recipes.method_es: 1 libra de azúcar blanca, el zumo de 6 limones, 1 cuarto (quart) de cerveza Guinness Stout, 1 cuarto de champán Lanson. Vierta sobre la mezcla de zumo de limón y azúcar el champán y la stout, bien fríos. Sirva en vasos de ponche adornados con fruta.
recipes.raw_text: Black and Tan Punch (For Party). 1 lb. white Sugar, juice of 6 Lemons, 1 quart Guinness Stout, 1 quart Lanson Champagne. Pour into mixture of lemon juice and sugar the Champagne and Stout, ice cold. Serve in punch glasses dressed with fruit.

recipes.method_original: In mixing vessel add: 3 1/2 lbs. of white Sugar, 1 1/2 gallons of G & W Special Rye, 2 quarts of Jamaica Rum, 14 Lemons, sliced, 2 Pineapples, sliced, 4 gallons of water. Pour into punch bowls in which a block of clear ice has been placed and decorate top of ice with berries or fruits in season.
recipes.method_es: En el recipiente de mezcla añada: 3 1/2 libras de azúcar blanca, 1 1/2 galones de G & W Special Rye, 2 cuartos (quarts) de ron de Jamaica, 14 limones en rodajas, 2 piñas en rodajas y 4 galones de agua. Vierta en cuencos de ponche en los que se haya colocado un bloque de hielo transparente y decore la parte superior del hielo con bayas o frutas de temporada.
recipes.garnish: Bayas o frutas de temporada sobre el hielo
recipes.raw_text: Canadian Punch. In mixing vessel add: 3 1/2 lbs. of white Sugar, 1 1/2 gallons of G & W Special Rye, 2 quarts of Jamaica Rum, 14 Lemons, sliced, 2 Pineapples, sliced, 4 gallons of water. Pour into punch bowls in which a block of clear ice has been placed and decorate top of ice with berries or fruits in season.

recipes.method_original: Brulee the rinds of 6 Lemons in 1 lb. of white Sugar and put the Sugar in a mixing vessel and add: 1 box Strawberries, 2 Lemons sliced, 6 Oranges sliced, 1 Pineapple cut into small pieces, 1 quart of Brandy, 1 quart Gonzalez Full Pale Rich Sherry, 1 quart Gonzalez Amontillado Sherry, 8 wineglasses of Cointreau Triple Sec. Stir well and empty into punch bowl in which block of clear ice has been placed and add: 2 quarts of Carbonated Water, 4 quarts of Lanson Champagne. Serve into punch glasses so that each person will have some of the fruit.
recipes.method_es: Queme (brulée) las cortezas de 6 limones en 1 libra de azúcar blanca y ponga el azúcar en un recipiente de mezcla y añada: 1 caja de fresas, 2 limones en rodajas, 6 naranjas en rodajas, 1 piña cortada en trozos pequeños, 1 cuarto (quart) de brandy, 1 cuarto de jerez Gonzalez Full Pale Rich, 1 cuarto de jerez Gonzalez Amontillado y 8 copas de vino de Cointreau Triple Sec. Remueva bien y vacíe en el cuenco de ponche en el que se haya colocado un bloque de hielo transparente y añada: 2 cuartos de agua carbonatada y 4 cuartos de champán Lanson. Sirva en vasos de ponche de modo que cada persona reciba algo de fruta.
recipes.glassware: cuenco de ponche / vasos de ponche
recipes.raw_text: Brulee the rinds of 6 Lemons in 1 lb. of white Sugar and put the Sugar in a mixing vessel and add: 1 box Strawberries, 2 Lemons sliced, 6 Oranges sliced, 1 Pineapple cut into small pieces, 1 quart of Brandy, 1 quart Gonzalez Full Pale Rich Sherry, 1 quart Gonzalez Amontillado Sherry, 8 wineglasses of Cointreau Triple Sec. Stir well and empty into punch bowl in which block of clear ice has been placed and add: 2 quarts of Carbonated Water, 4 quarts of Lanson Champagne. Serve into punch glasses so that each person will have some of the fruit.

recipes.method_original: Into a glass pitcher pour the juice of one lemon and add: 1/4 lb. of white Sugar, 1 wineglass of strawberry Syrup, 1 quart of Lanson Champagne. Stir with ladle and drop in: 1 sliced Orange, 3 slices of Pineapple. Decorate with fruit and serve in champagne goblets. Notice. - We will be pleased to supply friends with recipes for claret cups and punches of all descriptions at any time.
recipes.method_es: En una jarra de cristal vierta el zumo de un limón y añada: 1/4 de libra de azúcar blanca, 1 copa de vino de jarabe de fresa, 1 cuarto (quart) de champán Lanson. Remueva con un cucharón y eche dentro: 1 naranja en rodajas, 3 rodajas de piña. Decore con fruta y sirva en copas de champán. Aviso: estaremos encantados de facilitar a nuestros amigos recetas de copas de clarete y ponches de todas clases en cualquier momento.
recipes.garnish: Naranja en rodajas y rodajas de piña
recipes.raw_text: Champagne Punch (For 6 People). Into a glass pitcher pour the juice of one lemon and add: 1/4 lb. of white Sugar, 1 wineglass of strawberry Syrup, 1 quart of Lanson Champagne. Stir with ladle and drop in: 1 sliced Orange, 3 slices of Pineapple. Decorate with fruit and serve in champagne goblets.
